chapter_title_en: The Blazing Sun of Sword Force
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 593 - Mount Five Treasures: The Blazing Sun of Sword Force
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning begins his legendary cultivation of the Five Treasures Sword Art at Mount Five Treasures. He accepts the terrible price of forgetting all other Daos and achieves the Blazing Sun Stage of Sword Force. A quiet chapter of immense strategic depth.
og_title: Desolate Era: The 'Forgotten Dao' is the Sharpest Sword
og_description: Ji Ning enters the silent sanctuary of Mount Five Treasures. To master the ultimate sword art, he must let his other Daos vanish from memory. The price of peak power is absolute sacrifice.
twitter_description: Ji Ning systematically forgets his other Daos to master the Five Treasures Sword Art. A strategic chapter of quiet intensity. #Xianxia

lore_anchors.definition: The premier sword art of the Three Realms, created by Daofather Fuju. Its cultivation causes the practitioner to forget all other Daos, representing a path to transcendence beyond the Heavenly Dao.

The sacred mountain where Daofather Fuju left his complete sword art. Its presence is so profound that it suppresses life and creates a silent sanctuary for Empyrean Gods and True Immortals engaged in endless cultivation.
The power that manifests from deep mastery of the Grand Dao of the Sword, visualized by the light it emits: first stage is Silver Moon (银月境) and the second stage is Blazing Sun (耀日境).
The second stage of Sword Force, marked by a platinum-white light that naturally envelops the blade. At this stage, basic sword strikes can begin to tear through space itself.
The creator of the Five Treasures Sword Art. A figure of immense power and mystery who died in the endless Chaos, leaving his legacy on Mount Five Treasures as if he foresaw his own end.
A natural, infinitely profound seal that manifests within the primordial Chaos, considered even more complex than the Five Treasures Sword Art. Used by Ji Ning as a reference for his cultivation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the 'Five Treasures Sword Art' and why is it so special?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is the ultimate sword art of the Three Realms, created by Daofather Fuju. It represents a system that has completely transcended the Heavenly Dao, and mastering it is considered a sure path to reaching the apex of power, but it requires the practitioner to forget all other Daos.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Ji Ning let go of his other Daos?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because he doesn't have the endless time required to master multiple Daos. He is placing a 'bet' on a single, extreme path (Sword Force) that can make him a top-tier Daofather in the shortest possible time, a strategy known as 'walking a different path'.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the difference between 'Silver Moon' and 'Blazing Sun' Sword Force?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They represent the first and second stages of mastery. Silver Moon is a cooler, celestial light signifying initial understanding. Blazing Sun is a scorching platinum-white light that signifies a dominant, aggressive, and more powerful stage that can tear space.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How does Patriarch Subhuti fit into this chapter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is observing Ji Ning's progress from afar. Once he sees that Ji Ning's heart has calmed and his Sword Force has improved, he decides to re-introduce conflict with the Seamless Gate to sharpen his disciple through real combat.
